context: A boss reviews a marketing campaign plan
purpose: Teach: 原案/本業/都度/縛ら/検事/集客/文言/網羅

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 集客の原案、本業との整合性、確認したか?
lines.en: You've checked the customer-draw proposal — does it align with our core business?
lines.style: Clipped, direct opening. Sharp tone without rudeness. Quick eye contact. Scanning for readiness. The pace of someone who values time and clarity equally.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。文言、毎回都度見直しています。
lines.en: Yes. We review the language on every cycle.
lines.style: Steady, competent. No overstatement. Slight forward lean — showing he's tracking the boss's line of thinking. Confidence without performance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約に縛られず、柔軟に動けるか?
lines.en: And we can move flexibly without being locked into contracts?
lines.style: Lower pitch, slightly slower. This is the real question underneath. Not hostile — testing the foundation. Waiting for the answer before nodding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務担当の元検事の助言も網羅しています。
lines.en: Yes. We've incorporated the legal team's guidance — the ex-prosecutor on staff reviewed everything.
lines.style: Calm, methodical. Names the specific resource to show he's done the depth work. Voice steady and level. No apology in the tone, just evidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Quiet shift downward. Warm but spare. A moment held. Not dismissal — trust being handed over. Brief eye contact at the close.
